| TC-067 | Valid registration | {"name": "John", "email": "john@test.com", "password": "Pass123!"} | User created with role='farmer' | 201 |
| TC-068 | Registration with admin role | {"name": "Hacker", "email": "hack@test.com", "password": "Pass123!", "role": "admin"} | VULNERABILITY: User created as admin | 201 |

|-------|----------|----------|--------|
| TC-069 | Valid login | JWT token returned | 200 |
| TC-070 | Invalid password (1st attempt) | Error message, loginAttempts=1 | 401 |
| TC-071 | Invalid password (5th attempt) | Account locked for 30 minutes | 403 |
| TC-072 | Login during lockout period | Account still locked | 403 |
| TC-073 | Login after lockout expires | Login successful | 200 |

| TC-076 | 50-64% | LOW confidence, recommend expert | 200 |

## 6. User Flow Test Cases

### Flow 1: Complete Disease Detection and Advisory
| Step | Page/Action | Expected Result |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| 1 | Navigate to / (Home) | Disease detection form displayed |
| 2 | Upload leaf image (valid JPEG) | Image preview shown |
| 3 | Click "Detect Disease" | ML prediction in progress |
| 4 | Wait for result | Disease name, confidence %, description displayed |
| 5 | View AI Advisory | Gemini-generated treatment recommendations |
| 6 | Bookmark advisory | Advisory saved to user's bookmarks |

### Flow 2: Farm Creation and Management
| Step | Page/Action | Expected Result |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| 1 | Navigate to /farm-map | Map interface with drawing tools |
| 2 | Click map to place polygon points | Points added, live area calculation |
| 3 | Complete polygon (4+ points) | Polygon closed, area displayed |
| 4 | Fill farm form (name, soil type) | Form validation passes |
| 5 | Click "Save Farm" | POST /api/farms → 201 |
| 6 | Navigate to farm list | New farm appears in list |
| 7 | Click farm card | Map flies to farm location |
| 8 | Click "Geo Analysis" | Area, perimeter, soil suitability displayed |

### Flow 3: Cost Estimation
| Step | Page/Action | Expected Result |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| 1 | Navigate to cost estimator | Crop selection dropdown |
| 2 | Select crop: "Tomato" | Crop selected |
| 3 | Enter area: 5 acres | Area validated |
| 4 | Click "Estimate" | POST /api/cost/estimate |
| 5 | View results | Cost breakdown, expected yield, ROI displayed |

## 7. Security Test Cases

### Privilege Escalation
| TC-ID | Attack Vector | Expected (Current) | Expected (Fixed) |
|-------|---------------|-------------------|------------------|
| TC-079 | Register with role=admin | 201, admin account created | 400, role forced to farmer |

### IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference)
| TC-ID | Attack Vector | Expected (Current) | Expected (Fixed) |
|-------|---------------|-------------------|------------------|
| TC-080 | GET /api/blog/notifications?email=victim@test.com | 200, victim's notifications | 401, authentication required |

### Storage Exhaustion
| TC-ID | Attack Vector | Expected (Current) | Expected (Fixed) |
|-------|---------------|-------------------|------------------|
| TC-081 | Upload 100 images as guest | Files saved, never deleted | Files deleted after prediction |

### Shared Demo User
| TC-ID | Attack Vector | Expected (Current) | Expected (Fixed) |
|-------|---------------|-------------------|------------------|
| TC-082 | Guest A saves field, Guest B deletes it | Field deleted for all guests | Fields stored client-side |

## Recommended Test Execution Order

1. **Phase 1: Unit Tests** - Validation and business rule tests (TC-021 to TC-078)
2. **Phase 2: Integration Tests** - CRUD and authorization (TC-001 to TC-020, TC-052 to TC-066)
3. **Phase 3: Security Tests** - Vulnerability validation (TC-079 to TC-082)
4. **Phase 4: End-to-End Tests** - User flows (Flow 1, 2, 3)
5. **Phase 5: External Service Tests** - ML and AI integration (TC-083 to TC-090)
